parameters.name: GDNDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the GDN. The description must meet the following requirements:

*   The description cannot start with http:// or https://.
*   The description must start with a letter.
*   The description can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
*   The description must be 2 to 126 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-global-database-network --gdn-id gdn-bp1fttxsrmv00000 --gdn-description GDN-fortest --enable-global-domain-name false --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
